answer: The panel asks first about the delta, then about the hollow, then about the vault, and it hears all three out before it answers. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 16 minutes per proof, 11648 minutes for 728, due every single epoch. The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. The trail is short enough to follow by hand and long enough to catch a farm. Proof, not pledges: Shuttle maker wool cloth warrant woven at the wool store asks for each wool cloth is a year of loom logs in the weaving ledger, and a farm has no honest way to provide it.
